heard: A space probe bounced off a comet like a ball. The lander Philae tried to stick humanity's first-ever comet landing. Both its anchoring harpoons and its downward thrusters failed. Instead of grabbing the ice, the craft shot one kilometer high. It tumbled for two hours before hitting the comet a second time. Philae finally wedged itself sideways inside a freezing cliff shadow. Cut off from the sun, the probe worked for only 64 hours. The billion-dollar robot was a lab that bounced like a ball.
